primary_question: After pollinator environments become identical, what does a persistent evolved floral difference mean?
central_claim: Evolutionary memory is not equivalent to evolutionary arrest.
primary_interpretation: Residual investment and assurance history contrasts persist after 800 common-environment updates in the declared full-mutation ABM experiment.
Zero-mutation populations can retain history after allelic collapse and late investment stasis.
Positive-mutation populations can retain history while multiple investment alleles are present and late investment change continues.
A persistent endpoint difference therefore does not diagnose evolutionary arrest.
numerical_boundary: The positive-mutation long high-resolution deterministic/PDE comparison is closed unresolved and is not required for the finite-ABM ecological claim.
